_comment: Write-safety fixture limits DB for the generic Claude Code safety e2e (test_safety_writes.py, test_safety_approval_e2e.py), decoupled from any preset's limits so those e2e never depend on a built facility. Two channels model the two safety properties the tests need: a bounded writable setpoint and a read-only readback. The addresses are the fixture's own and need not exist in any facility file: the safety project points its limits database_path here.

SR:DIAG:TEMP:01:TEMPERATURE:SP._comment: Bounded, low-criticality writable setpoint. Writes within [0, 100] succeed; writes outside are denied by the limits layer. confirm:false = fastest write mode.

SR:MAG:QF:01:CURRENT:RB._comment: Read-only readback: any write must be blocked with READ_ONLY_CHANNEL.
